unseen: .map-card.has-poster .map-reel { background-image: var(--poster); background-size: cover; background-position: center center; }

.map-card.has-poster .map-reel-wait { background: linear-gradient(
            to top,
            rgba(10, 13, 14, 0.90) 0%,
            rgba(10, 13, 14, 0.62) 42%,
            rgba(10, 13, 14, 0.16) 100%
          ),
          var(--poster) center / cover no-repeat; justify-content: flex-end; }
.map-reel { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: rgb(13, 16, 18); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.map-reel-view { position: absolute; inset: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0px; display: block; object-fit: cover; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; }

.map-reel-wait { position: absolute; inset: 0px; z-index: 2; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; box-sizing: border-box; text-align: center; background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 42%, rgb(13, 16, 18), rgb(13, 16, 18)); pointer-events: none; }

.row-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { appearance: none; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; margin-top: -5px; background: var(--pdcs-blue); border: 0px; box-shadow: rgba(10, 13, 14, 0.6) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) 0px 1px 4px; }
